data.name: Rudyard
data.gender_notes: Rudyard is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rudyard is derived from the Old English words hrod, meaning 'fame' or 'renown,' and ger, meaning 'spear.' This name was popular among medieval knights and warriors, evoking images of courage and strength. The name Rudyard carries the meaning “Rule the spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rudyard usually hope their child will grow to embody rule the spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rudyard total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
